test_m1 = '''"""Test m1: @memoize decorated function has .memory attribute; calling .invalidate_all() makes .memory empty; subsequent calls recompute."""

import pytest


def test_memoize_has_memory():
    """The @memoize decorator should expose a .memory attribute on the wrapper."""
    from funcy.calc import memoize

    call_count = [0]

    @memoize
    def add(a, b):
        call_count[0] += 1
        return a + b

    # Call the function to populate memory
    result = add(1, 2)
    assert result == 3
    assert call_count[0] == 1

    # Check that .memory exists and has an entry
    assert hasattr(add, "memory")
    assert isinstance(add.memory, dict)
    assert len(add.memory) > 0


def test_invalidate_all_clears_memory():
    """Calling .invalidate_all() should clear the internal memory cache."""
    from funcy.calc import memoize

    call_count = [0]

    @memoize
    def multiply(a, b):
        call_count[0] += 1
        return a * b

    # Populate memory
    multiply(2, 3)
    assert call_count[0] == 1
    initial_size = len(multiply.memory)
    assert initial_size > 0

    # Invalidate all
    multiply.invalidate_all()

    # Memory should be empty now
    assert len(multiply.memory) == 0


def test_invalidate_all_triggers_recompute():
    """After .invalidate_all(), subsequent calls should recompute (not use cache)."""
    from funcy.calc import memoize

    call_count = [0]

    @memoize
    def subtract(a, b):
        call_count[0] += 1
        return a - b

    # First call - populates cache
    r1 = subtract(10, 3)
    assert r1 == 7
    assert call_count[0] == 1

    # Second call - uses cache
    r2 = subtract(10, 3)
    assert r2 == 7
    assert call_count[0] == 1  # No recomputation

    # Invalidate all
    subtract.invalidate_all()

    # Third call - must recompute since cache is cleared
    r3 = subtract(10, 3)
    assert r3 == 7
    assert call_count[0] == 2  # Recomputed!


def test_invalidate_all_is_callable():
    """.invalidate_all() must be a callable method on the wrapper."""
    from funcy.calc import memoize

    @memoize
    def identity(x):
        return x

    assert callable(getattr(identity, "invalidate_all", None))
'''

with open("crucible_hidden/test_m1.py", "w") as f:
